symptom_description: A frozen-backbone signed history corrector preserved the official Ctrl-World function and action sensitivity, and a decoupled execute-or-abstain router calibrated safely. However, the single global history-latent correction path did not beat simpler frozen correctors on independently held-out long-horizon quality, and both fixed correction directions were harmful on the held-out context.

experiment_evidence.observed_failure: B3 beat A0 on all three paired seeds and preserved action response, but lost to B1 and B2 on two of three seeds and failed all three aggregate quality gates. Its route correctly abstained because both fixed correction endpoints were harmful.
